title: Choose your Sunroom layout
question: All three share the selected visual world. Choose the composition to build; actual practitioner and clinic photos will replace illustrative faces and rooms.

options.label: A · The welcoming window
options.thesis: A personal welcome beside an arched massage photograph.
options.viewport: A two-column opening, with the photograph and the first practitioner section visible together.
options.risk: Most space-efficient; the practitioner cards must use the real photos.

options.label: B · The open conservatory
options.thesis: A centered invitation above one expansive photographic window.
options.viewport: A calm, broad hero with a full-width arch and clear centered action.
options.risk: The taller opening places practitioner discovery slightly further down.

options.label: C · The layered sunroom
options.thesis: A bold invitation with an intimate photo collage.
options.viewport: Large left typography, a tall massage arch and a smaller clinic photo overlapping.
options.risk: The clinic image will use the actual Birkdale room, not the illustrative room in the concept.
